judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: The comic husband afraid his wolf-wife will run off, the 'kind sir', the comma splice and the bare 'What are you waiting for?' reminder are all very Nox; but a 'raving demoness' leading the Ogres is lore the campaign never has, and the offer piles on stock fantasy phrasing ('horrific fate has befallen', 'worthy reward for its timely return').
